observation: Each installed flow discovers guidance, lets the harness decompose the objective, independently launches two constrained tasks, persists linked reports, analyzes two observed task groups, and enters missing/forged lineage, whole-skill-claim and cross-producer objective-deletion controls.
applied_identity: Effective authoritative lifecycle reports establish applied IDs separately for each task/decision/run. Terminal-only IDs, corrections and unrelated runs are covered; not_reported and different_plan retain unknown configuration details.
retention_recovery: Native production controls enter bounded cursor maintenance, nonoverlap, pause/cancel/interactive contention, unavailable-key handling, clock rollback, authenticated corruption, durable archival, one-year expiration and deletion/opt-out-before-import paths.
